hints.title: Alternating Group Requirement
hints.text: Adjacent elements in the chosen subsequence must have strictly different group IDs.

hints.title: Greedy Alternation
hints.text: Because groups are binary (0 or 1), greedily taking every element that differs from the previous selected group achieves maximum possible length.

hints.title: Subsequence Extraction
hints.text: Start by taking the first word, then append every subsequent word whose group does not equal the group of the last added word.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) memory for the output subsequence.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize greedy alternation on binary groups.
